title: A structure-preserving Numerical Method for the Compressible Resistive-Hall-MHD System
summary: In this paper, we present a structure-preserving method for the compressible resistive Hall-magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) model. The differential operator is split into two parts: a hydrodynamic part consisting of the compressible Euler equations, and a magnetic part consisting of a system coupling the Lorentz force and the induction equation. The method uses continuous Lagrange elements for the Euler part and a curl-conforming finite element space for the magnetic part.
